title: Warm Spicy Polish Beet Pasta
description: A spicy and adventurous Polish dish featuring beets and a pasta water emulsion, perfect for pescatarian diets. This recipe combines the sweetness of beets with the heat of spicy peppers.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the sliced spicy polish sausage to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced beets to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Add the beet juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the beet and sausage mixture.
Season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional beet juice if desired.
